title: Adoption Contract — draft 0.1.0
description: Piece 2 of the growth layer: the control gate that makes a decision effective. An adoption request carries the piece-0 identity (three-layer), the P5 versions, the payload digest, and the grants in effect at the decision point (for the dispatch-time authority recheck: pin content while rechecking applicable live authority — 07 proposal §3 authority provider, §7 commit boundary, M05). State machine states: adopted → dispatched | unresolved (timeout / crash at the dispatch boundary, first-class) → completed/failed — the machine has no acquire state; the adoption event is the entry point. Same key + same digest resolves the original receipt; changed material content does not silently replace it — a conflict (07 §3 command paragraph, §7 Idempotence: a client key alone gives no server guarantee). Provenance (dual anchor): semantics per the current NGA architecture proposal §3/§6/§7 and overall-design P3/P5; formerly NGA overall-design §7, 14-A5, 15-graph-loop §B4 (superseded by the 2026-10-31 consolidation into the single current proposal). All 'proposed' status — this schema is an evidence-track probe answer, not an NGA commitment.

versions.description: P5 five-dimension version binding (what the decision actually consumed).

payload_digest.description: sha256 hex of JCS(request payload). The idempotency key is operation_id + payload_digest; a changed payload under the same key is a rejection.

grants_at_decision.description: The caller's grant set pinned at the decision point — the dispatch-time authority recheck (14-A4: initial admission guarantees nothing about later permission) compares the live grant set against this snapshot.

accountability.description: Festival D31 triple riding the same event (join point with the ledger).
